_meta.scope: First-class non-OMC/non-OMX project hook runtime for Codex and Gemini. Claude Code hook orchestration is owned by OMC; project .claude/settings.json intentionally carries no runtime hook commands.
_meta.purpose: Declare the only runtime hooks that project Codex/Gemini configs may reference, their side-effect envelope, and the bootstrap exception boundary so stale/missing hook references are removed rather than silently tolerated. Canonical primitives now live as direct machine-readable authority at specs/canonical-primitives.json instead of a SessionStart runtime hook.

runtime_contract.side_effects: stdout/stderr advisory guidance only; no project-state mutation
runtime_contract.exit_behavior: non-blocking unless the script itself has a syntax/runtime error under test
forbidden_runtime_behaviors: spawning agent CLIs such as codex exec, claude, or gemini from tools/hooks/*.sh
git push or PR mutation from tools/hooks/*.sh
rm -rf or filesystem cleanup from tools/hooks/*.sh

runtime_hooks.purpose: Advisory Buck2/no-cargo guidance for shell commands.

bootstrap_boundary.network_policy: May use gh/curl only during explicit operator bootstrap or --sync-skills to check/fetch addyosmani/agent-skills. Runtime hooks must not perform network calls.
bootstrap_boundary.destructive_operations_policy: May replace tools/agent-skills/ only during explicit sync. Must not be referenced by runtime hook configs.
